Actually, no - 9.9 is greater than 9.11.

When comparing decimal numbers, it helps to align the decimal places:
- 9.90 (this is the same as 9.9)
- 9.11

Looking at the tenths place: 9 > 1, so 9.9 is larger than 9.11.

Another way to think about it: 9.9 is nine and nine-tenths, while 9.11 is nine and eleven-hundredths. Nine-tenths (0.9) is much larger than eleven-hundredths (0.11).
